reader.requirement: At 85 a relative-file DELETE, READ, REWRITE, START or WRITE that meets the invalid key condition is unsuccessful with a 2x status (22 duplicate; 23 record absent, or START/random READ of an absent optional input file; 24 a write beyond the file's boundaries or a sequential WRITE whose record number overflows the RELATIVE KEY item), leaves the file unaffected, and takes INVALID KEY, else the USE procedure.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError (from 2014): a random or dynamic WRITE whose key is below 1 or above the highest RRN answers the invalid key 24 at 85, the permanent error 34 at 2014 and 2023

reader.edition-search: grep -rn 'CobolVersion|Edition|Dialect|Std' src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/*.cs; grep -n 'Edition|Version|Dialect' CodeGen/EcEmitter.cs CodeGen/DispatchEmitter.cs CodeGen/Verbs/IoStatusClass.cs; read Runtime/Control/DialectBehavior.cs rows 2, 14, 19
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: a random or dynamic WRITE with RELATIVE KEY 0 is the invalid key condition 24 at 85 (INVALID KEY taken, the file still usable) and the permanent error 34 at 2014/2023 (no INVALID KEY, the error stays in effect)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers 22 and 23 on WRITE/READ/REWRITE/DELETE/START; not exercised there: 24 in either form and 23 for an absent optional file (probed)

reader.notes: The one edition arm on the path is RelativeConnector.Write's out-of-range key; at 85 it takes BoundaryViolation (24), as §1985:VIII.1.3.4 GRL2.3c reads, and the probe shows both arms. The status class tests (CodeGen/Verbs/IoStatusClass.cs), the generated __IoCheck hook (DispatchEmitter.EmitUseMachinery) and the Status setter's permanent-error record are the same code at every edition.
